thread:
Eli (Marketing): Quick sync — target publish: Wed 10/02 09:00 PT. Need final changelog anchor, docs release URL, a 1-liner bench stat we can put in the hero, and confirmation of webinar embed + signup funnel. cc @Ravi @Jordan :calendar:

Ravi (ProdEng): Canary starts Tue 10/01 16:00 PT. No blockers now but I'm still validating long-tail perf. Early numbers: ~30-45% cost down for <128-token prompts with new batching + cache policy. Happy with saying 'up to 45%'.

Jordan (Docs): Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/498 — includes migration notes and the "breaking changes" callout. I'll need the changelog snippet to add to release notes. Also will publish the /release/1.7 page once you confirm copy.

Eli (Marketing): Suggested hero line: "Up to 45% lower inference cost for short prompts — faster responses for interactive apps." Is that too marketing-y? Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Ravi (ProdEng): Suggest tweak to be precise: "Up to 45% lower per-request cost on short prompts with improved batching and KV caching." Removes vague 'faster' unless we quantify latency.

Kai (DevRel): Webinar plan: live demo + Q&A Thu 10/03 10:00 PT. We can embed a Calendly widget in the blog and send registrants to the DevRel queue. I can provide the recording and a short demo gist.

Priya (Growth): Inbound routing: HubSpot form w/ hidden field campaign=release_oct24, tag registrants "release_oct24", then Zap to #sales-inbound. We'll add UTMs utm_campaign=release_oct24&utm_medium=blog&utm_source=redwood. Also set auto-email with recording + "how-to" snippet.

Jordan (Docs): Draft changelog snippet: ```
Performance: batching + KV-cache updates reduce per-request cost by up to 45% on short prompts. See release notes & benchmark notebook.
```
OK for release notes?

Eli (Marketing): That's great. Can we also get the public benchmark notebook link for the post? Ravi?

Ravi (ProdEng): Public bench notebook: https://internal.redwood/bench/2024-10-01-summary (we'll open a sanitized copy for public link: https://bench.redwood.ai/2024-10-01). Use the public one in the blog.

release-bot: Scheduled rollout: canary window opens 1738876800 (2024-10-01T16:00:00Z). Watchers: @prod-eng, @eng-oncall.

Priya (Growth): Also recommend a small A/B on hero messaging: A) "Up to 45% lower per-request cost..." vs B) "Make short prompt interactions 30-45% cheaper" — we'll run for 24h and pick winner. I'll wire the experiment in the post CMS.

Kai (DevRel): I'll include the webinar CTA and script for the DevRel handoff. Also can host an office hours 1:1 the day after go-live for larger customers.

Jordan (Docs): Final docs link ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1.7. Changelog permalink: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/compare/v1.6.3...v1.7.0#perf-batching-kvcache

Eli (Marketing): Sweet. I'll schedule the post and include both hero variants for A/B. Final checks: use the public bench link, docs link above, changelog permalink, webinar embed for Thu 10/03 10:00 PT. If no objections by EOD, we publish as planned.

Ravi (ProdEng): LGTM.

Priya (Growth): LGTM.

Kai (DevRel): LGTM.
